scope: Synthetic local microbenchmarks; no live database, no end-to-end throughput claim.

commands.rust_baseline: cd native; cargo bench -p odbc_engine --bench bulk_parse_bench --offline -- --warm-up-time 1 --measurement-time 2 --sample-size 30 --save-baseline review_before
commands.rust_candidate: cd native; cargo bench -p odbc_engine --bench bulk_parse_bench --offline -- --warm-up-time 1 --measurement-time 2 --sample-size 30 --baseline review_before

reproduction: For unpaired runs, use the same benchmark and fixture files against baseline and candidate production sources. Run before/after, then after/before, without concurrent workloads. Columnar AOT embeds the historical baseline and alternates timing order in one process.
limitations: Independent columnar JIT/AOT processes showed substantial environmental drift; their comparisons are diagnostic only, not evidence of a regression or a gain.
Worker reflection is VM-only fixture setup; measured paths use direct calls, not reflection. No isolates or native driver are started.
Rust legacy 1024x64 confidence interval overlaps zero: no demonstrated improvement.

validation.clippy: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings: exit 0; only filesystem hard-link cache warnings
